"""Compare promised records, including missing values, without fixing dtypes or row order."""
import pandas as _pd

def _assert_records(_actual, _expected, _label, *, keys=None, ordered=False):
    assert isinstance(_actual, _pd.DataFrame), f'{_label} должна быть таблицей DataFrame.'
    assert _actual.columns.is_unique, f'{_label}: названия столбцов не должны повторяться.'
    _missing = [c for c in _expected.columns if c not in _actual.columns]
    assert not _missing, f'{_label}: отсутствуют столбцы {_missing}.'
    assert len(_actual) == len(_expected), f'{_label}: {_actual.shape[0]} строк, ожидалось {len(_expected)}. Проверьте отбор анкет.'
    _a = _actual[list(_expected.columns)].copy()
    _w = _expected.copy()
    if keys:
        assert not _a.duplicated(keys).any(), f'{_label}: ключ {keys} повторяется.'
    if not ordered:
        _sort = keys or list(_expected.columns)
        _a = _a.sort_values(_sort)
        _w = _w.sort_values(_sort)
    _a = _a.reset_index(drop=True)
    _w = _w.reset_index(drop=True)
    for _col in _w.columns:
        try:
            _pd.testing.assert_series_equal(_a[_col], _w[_col], check_dtype=False,
                                           check_categorical=False, check_names=False,
                                           check_exact=True)
        except AssertionError:
            raise AssertionError(f'{_label}: значения столбца {_col} не совпадают с исходными записями после нужных шагов. Сохраняйте содержимое выбранной анкеты и привязку к ключу.') from None

setup:
import pandas as _pd0
def _ref_clean(raw):
    syn = {'соц. сети': 'соцсети', 'от друзей': 'друзья', 'проходил мимо': 'мимо', '2гис': 'карты', 'яндекс карты': 'карты'}
    d = raw.drop_duplicates().copy()
    d['client_id'] = d['client_id'].str.strip().str.upper()
    d['name'] = d['name'].str.strip().str.capitalize()
    d['gender'] = d['gender'].str.strip().str.lower().map({'м': 'М', 'муж': 'М', 'ж': 'Ж', 'жен': 'Ж'})
    b = _pd0.to_datetime(d['birth_date'], format='%Y-%m-%d', errors='coerce').fillna(
        _pd0.to_datetime(d['birth_date'], format='%d.%m.%Y', errors='coerce'))
    d['birth_date'] = b.where((2026 - b.dt.year - (b.dt.strftime('%m%d') > '1201')).between(14, 100))
    d['city'] = (d['city'].str.strip().str.lower().str.removeprefix('г.').str.strip()
                 .replace({'екб': 'екатеринбург'}).str.capitalize())
    d['phone'] = d['phone'].str.replace(r'\D', '', regex=True).where(d['phone'].str.replace(r'\D', '', regex=True).str.fullmatch(r'[78]?\d{10}')).str[-10:]
    d['signup_date'] = _pd0.to_datetime(d['signup_date'])
    n = _pd0.to_numeric(d['bonus'].str.replace(' ', ''), errors='coerce')
    d['bonus'] = n.mask((n < 0) | (n > 10_000))
    d['source'] = d['source'].str.strip().str.lower().replace(syn)
    return d.sort_values('signup_date').drop_duplicates('client_id', keep='last').reset_index(drop=True)
def _ref_clients():
    return _ref_clean(_pd0.read_csv('clients_raw.csv'))
def _ref_orders():
    o = _pd0.read_csv('orders_3m.csv')
    o['datetime'] = _pd0.to_datetime(o['datetime'])
    return o
def _ref_age(c):
    a = 2026 - c['birth_date'].dt.year - (c['birth_date'].dt.strftime('%m%d') > '1201')
    g = _pd0.cut(a, bins=[14, 25, 35, 45, 60, 101], labels=['14–24', '25–34', '35–44', '45–59', '60–100'], right=False)
    return a, g
def _ref_lump(s):
    vc = s.value_counts()
    return s.where(s.isin(vc[vc >= 10].index) | s.isna(), 'прочее')
def _ref_guests(c=None, o=None):
    c = _ref_clients() if c is None else c.copy()
    o = _ref_orders() if o is None else o
    st = o.groupby('client_id').agg(orders=('order_id', 'count'), revenue=('amount', 'sum'))
    g = c.merge(st, left_on='client_id', right_index=True, how='left')
    g['orders'] = g['orders'].fillna(0)
    g['revenue'] = g['revenue'].fillna(0)
    g['age'], g['age_group'] = _ref_age(g)
    g['source'] = _ref_lump(g['source'].fillna('не указано'))
    return g

import pandas as pd

SYNONYMS = {"соц. сети": "соцсети", "от друзей": "друзья", "проходил мимо": "мимо",
            "2гис": "карты", "яндекс карты": "карты"}

def clean_city(s):
    return (s.str.strip().str.lower().str.removeprefix("г.").str.strip()
             .replace({"екб": "екатеринбург"}).str.capitalize())

def clean_phone(s):
    digits = s.str.replace(r"\D", "", regex=True)
    ok = digits.str.fullmatch(r"[78]?\d{10}")      # 10 цифр или 11 с кодом 7/8
    return digits.where(ok).str[-10:]               # другие длины — пропуск, а не «похожий» номер

def clean_gender(s):
    return s.str.strip().str.lower().map({"м": "М", "муж": "М", "ж": "Ж", "жен": "Ж"})

def parse_birth(s):
    iso = pd.to_datetime(s, format="%Y-%m-%d", errors="coerce")
    ru = pd.to_datetime(s, format="%d.%m.%Y", errors="coerce")
    born = iso.fillna(ru)
    return born.where((2026 - born.dt.year - (born.dt.strftime('%m%d') > '1201')).between(14, 100))

def clean_bonus(s):
    b = pd.to_numeric(s.str.replace(" ", ""), errors="coerce")
    return b.mask((b < 0) | (b > 10_000))

def clean_clients(raw):
    df = raw.drop_duplicates().copy()
    df["client_id"] = df["client_id"].str.strip().str.upper()
    df["name"] = df["name"].str.strip().str.capitalize()
    df["gender"] = clean_gender(df["gender"])
    df["birth_date"] = parse_birth(df["birth_date"])
    df["city"] = clean_city(df["city"])
    df["phone"] = clean_phone(df["phone"])
    df["signup_date"] = pd.to_datetime(df["signup_date"])
    df["bonus"] = clean_bonus(df["bonus"])
    df["source"] = df["source"].str.strip().str.lower().replace(SYNONYMS)
    return (df.sort_values("signup_date")
              .drop_duplicates(subset=["client_id"], keep="last")
              .reset_index(drop=True))

def report(raw, orders):
    raw=pd.read_csv("clients_raw.csv")
    clients = clean_clients(raw)
    stats = orders.groupby("client_id").agg(orders=("order_id", "count"), revenue=("amount", "sum"))
    guests = clients.merge(stats, on="client_id", how="left")
    guests[["orders", "revenue"]] = guests[["orders", "revenue"]].fillna(0)
    age = 2026 - guests["birth_date"].dt.year - (guests["birth_date"].dt.strftime("%m%d") > "1201")
    active = guests[guests["orders"] > 0]
    return {
        "clients": len(guests),
        "active_pct": round((guests["orders"] > 0).mean() * 100, 1),
        "median_age": age.median(),
        "avg_revenue_active": round(active["revenue"].mean(), 1),
    }

raw = pd.read_csv("clients_raw.csv")
orders = pd.read_csv("orders_3m.csv", parse_dates=["datetime"])
report(raw, orders)

import pandas as _pd0
def _ref_clean(raw):
    syn = {'соц. сети': 'соцсети', 'от друзей': 'друзья', 'проходил мимо': 'мимо', '2гис': 'карты', 'яндекс карты': 'карты'}
    d = raw.drop_duplicates().copy()
    d['client_id'] = d['client_id'].str.strip().str.upper()
    d['name'] = d['name'].str.strip().str.capitalize()
    d['gender'] = d['gender'].str.strip().str.lower().map({'м': 'М', 'муж': 'М', 'ж': 'Ж', 'жен': 'Ж'})
    b = _pd0.to_datetime(d['birth_date'], format='%Y-%m-%d', errors='coerce').fillna(
        _pd0.to_datetime(d['birth_date'], format='%d.%m.%Y', errors='coerce'))
    d['birth_date'] = b.where((2026 - b.dt.year - (b.dt.strftime('%m%d') > '1201')).between(14, 100))
    d['city'] = (d['city'].str.strip().str.lower().str.removeprefix('г.').str.strip()
                 .replace({'екб': 'екатеринбург'}).str.capitalize())
    d['phone'] = d['phone'].str.replace(r'\D', '', regex=True).where(d['phone'].str.replace(r'\D', '', regex=True).str.fullmatch(r'[78]?\d{10}')).str[-10:]
    d['signup_date'] = _pd0.to_datetime(d['signup_date'])
    n = _pd0.to_numeric(d['bonus'].str.replace(' ', ''), errors='coerce')
    d['bonus'] = n.mask((n < 0) | (n > 10_000))
    d['source'] = d['source'].str.strip().str.lower().replace(syn)
    return d.sort_values('signup_date').drop_duplicates('client_id', keep='last').reset_index(drop=True)
def _ref_clients():
    return _ref_clean(_pd0.read_csv('clients_raw.csv'))
def _ref_orders():
    o = _pd0.read_csv('orders_3m.csv')
    o['datetime'] = _pd0.to_datetime(o['datetime'])
    return o
def _ref_age(c):
    a = 2026 - c['birth_date'].dt.year - (c['birth_date'].dt.strftime('%m%d') > '1201')
    g = _pd0.cut(a, bins=[14, 25, 35, 45, 60, 101], labels=['14–24', '25–34', '35–44', '45–59', '60–100'], right=False)
    return a, g
def _ref_lump(s):
    vc = s.value_counts()
    return s.where(s.isin(vc[vc >= 10].index) | s.isna(), 'прочее')
def _ref_guests(c=None, o=None):
    c = _ref_clients() if c is None else c.copy()
    o = _ref_orders() if o is None else o
    st = o.groupby('client_id').agg(orders=('order_id', 'count'), revenue=('amount', 'sum'))
    g = c.merge(st, left_on='client_id', right_index=True, how='left')
    g['orders'] = g['orders'].fillna(0)
    g['revenue'] = g['revenue'].fillna(0)
    g['age'], g['age_group'] = _ref_age(g)
    g['source'] = _ref_lump(g['source'].fillna('не указано'))
    return g

"""Compare promised records, including missing values, without fixing dtypes or row order."""
import pandas as _pd

def _assert_records(_actual, _expected, _label, *, keys=None, ordered=False):
    assert isinstance(_actual, _pd.DataFrame), f'{_label} должна быть таблицей DataFrame.'
    assert _actual.columns.is_unique, f'{_label}: названия столбцов не должны повторяться.'
    _missing = [c for c in _expected.columns if c not in _actual.columns]
    assert not _missing, f'{_label}: отсутствуют столбцы {_missing}.'
    assert len(_actual) == len(_expected), f'{_label}: {_actual.shape[0]} строк, ожидалось {len(_expected)}. Проверьте отбор анкет.'
    _a = _actual[list(_expected.columns)].copy()
    _w = _expected.copy()
    if keys:
        assert not _a.duplicated(keys).any(), f'{_label}: ключ {keys} повторяется.'
    if not ordered:
        _sort = keys or list(_expected.columns)
        _a = _a.sort_values(_sort)
        _w = _w.sort_values(_sort)
    _a = _a.reset_index(drop=True)
    _w = _w.reset_index(drop=True)
    for _col in _w.columns:
        try:
            _pd.testing.assert_series_equal(_a[_col], _w[_col], check_dtype=False,
                                           check_categorical=False, check_names=False,
                                           check_exact=True)
        except AssertionError:
            raise AssertionError(f'{_label}: значения столбца {_col} не совпадают с исходными записями после нужных шагов. Сохраняйте содержимое выбранной анкеты и привязку к ключу.') from None
_assert_records(c, d.drop_duplicates(), 'clean')

"""Compare promised records, including missing values, without fixing dtypes or row order."""
import pandas as _pd

def _assert_records(_actual, _expected, _label, *, keys=None, ordered=False):
    assert isinstance(_actual, _pd.DataFrame), f'{_label} должна быть таблицей DataFrame.'
    assert _actual.columns.is_unique, f'{_label}: названия столбцов не должны повторяться.'
    _missing = [c for c in _expected.columns if c not in _actual.columns]
    assert not _missing, f'{_label}: отсутствуют столбцы {_missing}.'
    assert len(_actual) == len(_expected), f'{_label}: {_actual.shape[0]} строк, ожидалось {len(_expected)}. Проверьте отбор анкет.'
    _a = _actual[list(_expected.columns)].copy()
    _w = _expected.copy()
    if keys:
        assert not _a.duplicated(keys).any(), f'{_label}: ключ {keys} повторяется.'
    if not ordered:
        _sort = keys or list(_expected.columns)
        _a = _a.sort_values(_sort)
        _w = _w.sort_values(_sort)
    _a = _a.reset_index(drop=True)
    _w = _w.reset_index(drop=True)
    for _col in _w.columns:
        try:
            _pd.testing.assert_series_equal(_a[_col], _w[_col], check_dtype=False,
                                           check_categorical=False, check_names=False,
                                           check_exact=True)
        except AssertionError:
            raise AssertionError(f'{_label}: значения столбца {_col} не совпадают с исходными записями после нужных шагов. Сохраняйте содержимое выбранной анкеты и привязку к ключу.') from None

import pandas as _pd0
def _ref_clean(raw):
    syn = {'соц. сети': 'соцсети', 'от друзей': 'друзья', 'проходил мимо': 'мимо', '2гис': 'карты', 'яндекс карты': 'карты'}
    d = raw.drop_duplicates().copy()
    d['client_id'] = d['client_id'].str.strip().str.upper()
    d['name'] = d['name'].str.strip().str.capitalize()
    d['gender'] = d['gender'].str.strip().str.lower().map({'м': 'М', 'муж': 'М', 'ж': 'Ж', 'жен': 'Ж'})
    b = _pd0.to_datetime(d['birth_date'], format='%Y-%m-%d', errors='coerce').fillna(
        _pd0.to_datetime(d['birth_date'], format='%d.%m.%Y', errors='coerce'))
    d['birth_date'] = b.where((2026 - b.dt.year - (b.dt.strftime('%m%d') > '1201')).between(14, 100))
    d['city'] = (d['city'].str.strip().str.lower().str.removeprefix('г.').str.strip()
                 .replace({'екб': 'екатеринбург'}).str.capitalize())
    d['phone'] = d['phone'].str.replace(r'\D', '', regex=True).where(d['phone'].str.replace(r'\D', '', regex=True).str.fullmatch(r'[78]?\d{10}')).str[-10:]
    d['signup_date'] = _pd0.to_datetime(d['signup_date'])
    n = _pd0.to_numeric(d['bonus'].str.replace(' ', ''), errors='coerce')
    d['bonus'] = n.mask((n < 0) | (n > 10_000))
    d['source'] = d['source'].str.strip().str.lower().replace(syn)
    return d.sort_values('signup_date').drop_duplicates('client_id', keep='last').reset_index(drop=True)
def _ref_clients():
    return _ref_clean(_pd0.read_csv('clients_raw.csv'))
def _ref_orders():
    o = _pd0.read_csv('orders_3m.csv')
    o['datetime'] = _pd0.to_datetime(o['datetime'])
    return o
def _ref_age(c):
    a = 2026 - c['birth_date'].dt.year - (c['birth_date'].dt.strftime('%m%d') > '1201')
    g = _pd0.cut(a, bins=[14, 25, 35, 45, 60, 101], labels=['14–24', '25–34', '35–44', '45–59', '60–100'], right=False)
    return a, g
def _ref_lump(s):
    vc = s.value_counts()
    return s.where(s.isin(vc[vc >= 10].index) | s.isna(), 'прочее')
def _ref_guests(c=None, o=None):
    c = _ref_clients() if c is None else c.copy()
    o = _ref_orders() if o is None else o
    st = o.groupby('client_id').agg(orders=('order_id', 'count'), revenue=('amount', 'sum'))
    g = c.merge(st, left_on='client_id', right_index=True, how='left')
    g['orders'] = g['orders'].fillna(0)
    g['revenue'] = g['revenue'].fillna(0)
    g['age'], g['age_group'] = _ref_age(g)
    g['source'] = _ref_lump(g['source'].fillna('не указано'))
    return g

import pandas as _pd0
def _ref_clean(raw):
    syn = {'соц. сети': 'соцсети', 'от друзей': 'друзья', 'проходил мимо': 'мимо', '2гис': 'карты', 'яндекс карты': 'карты'}
    d = raw.drop_duplicates().copy()
    d['client_id'] = d['client_id'].str.strip().str.upper()
    d['name'] = d['name'].str.strip().str.capitalize()
    d['gender'] = d['gender'].str.strip().str.lower().map({'м': 'М', 'муж': 'М', 'ж': 'Ж', 'жен': 'Ж'})
    b = _pd0.to_datetime(d['birth_date'], format='%Y-%m-%d', errors='coerce').fillna(
        _pd0.to_datetime(d['birth_date'], format='%d.%m.%Y', errors='coerce'))
    d['birth_date'] = b.where((2026 - b.dt.year - (b.dt.strftime('%m%d') > '1201')).between(14, 100))
    d['city'] = (d['city'].str.strip().str.lower().str.removeprefix('г.').str.strip()
                 .replace({'екб': 'екатеринбург'}).str.capitalize())
    d['phone'] = d['phone'].str.replace(r'\D', '', regex=True).where(d['phone'].str.replace(r'\D', '', regex=True).str.fullmatch(r'[78]?\d{10}')).str[-10:]
    d['signup_date'] = _pd0.to_datetime(d['signup_date'])
    n = _pd0.to_numeric(d['bonus'].str.replace(' ', ''), errors='coerce')
    d['bonus'] = n.mask((n < 0) | (n > 10_000))
    d['source'] = d['source'].str.strip().str.lower().replace(syn)
    return d.sort_values('signup_date').drop_duplicates('client_id', keep='last').reset_index(drop=True)
def _ref_clients():
    return _ref_clean(_pd0.read_csv('clients_raw.csv'))
def _ref_orders():
    o = _pd0.read_csv('orders_3m.csv')
    o['datetime'] = _pd0.to_datetime(o['datetime'])
    return o
def _ref_age(c):
    a = 2026 - c['birth_date'].dt.year - (c['birth_date'].dt.strftime('%m%d') > '1201')
    g = _pd0.cut(a, bins=[14, 25, 35, 45, 60, 101], labels=['14–24', '25–34', '35–44', '45–59', '60–100'], right=False)
    return a, g
def _ref_lump(s):
    vc = s.value_counts()
    return s.where(s.isin(vc[vc >= 10].index) | s.isna(), 'прочее')
def _ref_guests(c=None, o=None):
    c = _ref_clients() if c is None else c.copy()
    o = _ref_orders() if o is None else o
    st = o.groupby('client_id').agg(orders=('order_id', 'count'), revenue=('amount', 'sum'))
    g = c.merge(st, left_on='client_id', right_index=True, how='left')
    g['orders'] = g['orders'].fillna(0)
    g['revenue'] = g['revenue'].fillna(0)
    g['age'], g['age_group'] = _ref_age(g)
    g['source'] = _ref_lump(g['source'].fillna('не указано'))
    return g
clients = _ref_clients()
orders = _ref_orders()

import pandas as pd

def lump(s, min_count):
    counts = s.value_counts()
    frequent = counts[counts >= min_count].index
    return s.where(s.isin(frequent) | s.isna(), "прочее")

guests["source"] = lump(guests["source"].fillna("не указано"), 10)
guests["active"] = guests["orders"] > 0
by_source = guests.groupby("source").agg(
    clients=("client_id", "count"),
    active_pct=("active", "mean"),
    avg_revenue=("revenue", "mean"),
)
by_source["active_pct"] = (by_source["active_pct"] * 100).round(1)
by_source["avg_revenue"] = by_source["avg_revenue"].round(0)
by_source = by_source.sort_values("clients", ascending=False)
big = by_source[by_source["clients"] >= 20]
best_source = big["avg_revenue"].idxmax()

    a = 2026 - c['birth_date'].dt.year - (c['birth_date'].dt.strftime('%m%d') > '1201')
    g = _pd0.cut(a, bins=[14, 25, 35, 45, 60, 101], labels=['14–24', '25–34', '35–44', '45–59', '60–100'], right=False)
    return a, g
def _ref_lump(s):
    vc = s.value_counts()
    return s.where(s.isin(vc[vc >= 10].index) | s.isna(), 'прочее')
def _ref_guests(c=None, o=None):
    c = _ref_clients() if c is None else c.copy()
    o = _ref_orders() if o is None else o
    st = o.groupby('client_id').agg(orders=('order_id', 'count'), revenue=('amount', 'sum'))
    g = c.merge(st, left_on='client_id', right_index=True, how='left')
    g['orders'] = g['orders'].fillna(0)
    g['revenue'] = g['revenue'].fillna(0)
    g['age'], g['age_group'] = _ref_age(g)
    g['source'] = _ref_lump(g['source'].fillna('не указано'))
    return g
